Build and own the supply side: negotiate discounts, terms, and reliable availability with wholesalers and suppliers. Build and own the demand side: sign, onboard, and grow a base of large garages, and own B2B field sales. Build and lead the founding team and the key relationships: wholesalers, garage chains, insurers, and the studio / IC. Hands-on studio support: a venture team working alongside you from day one.
